comment: MATLAB Signal Toolbox vco (Phase 4.8) — voltage-controlled oscillator. y = cos(2π·Fc·t + range1·cumsum(x)), where range1 = (Fc/Fs)·2π for scalar Fc, or (Fmax-Fc)/Fs·2π for [Fmin Fmax] (Fc=mean(range)).
